exposure: Pre-pregnancy body mass index (BMI): Underweight (< 18.5 kg/m2), Normal weight (18.5-24.9 kg/m2), Overweight (25.0-29.9 kg/m2), and Obesity (>= 30.0 kg/m2)
cohort: 12,712 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) from Xi'an, Northwest China, between January 2015 and December 2018
finding: The study identified a more stringent GWG range than current recommendations for GDM women based on pre-pregnancy BMI, with lower GWG associated with reduced risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
